Coach’s board · New York Knicks

Mike Brown.

Knicks head coach since 2025. The Knicks are 10–6, 5th in the East.

Knicks at Raptors · Nov 15 · overtime

Brunson's corner fadeaway.

The overtime play out of a timeout that beat the Raptors, drawn on the board.

  1. The timeout. Tied 106–106 in overtime, 35 seconds left. The Knicks take a timeout.
  2. The screen. Towns steps up and screens for Brunson.
  3. The run. Brunson comes off it and runs to the left corner.
  4. The inbound. Bridges finds him from under the basket.
  5. The fadeaway. Brunson fades away and hits the three. Knicks by 3, and they win 112–108.
